data.name: Rauliel
data.gender_notes: Rauliel is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew name Raul, meaning 'friend' and the suffix -iel, meaning 'God'. Therefore, Rauliel translates to 'friend of God'. In Christianity, this name is associated with various saints and figures of faith. The name Rauliel carries the meaning “Friend of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Rauliel usually hope their child will grow to embody friend of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Signifies a deep bond and connection with God.
data.etymology: Rauliel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friend of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rauliel total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_english.long_meaning: The name Rauliel means joy in the name of the Lord. It is derived from Hebrew roots meaning joy and in the name of the Lord. Joy in the name of the Lord is a central concept in Christianity, symbolizing the happiness and peace that comes from knowing and serving God.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rauliel carries a unique and intriguing blend of Hebrew and Christian influences. Its Hebrew roots emphasize the importance of friendship in human relationships, while its Christian suffix highlights the believer's companionship with God. Throughout history, Rauliel has been a meaningful name for those who value their faith and cherish their friendships, particularly within Christian communities.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Rauliel is deeply rooted in the concept of a profound understanding of the friendship between God and humanity. It symbolizes the believer's desire to be close to and in communion with God. The name serves as a daily reminder of the belief that God is not only present in one's life, but is also a cherished friend. Rauliel represents the journey of strengthening that bond and living a life inspired by that unwavering companionship.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Rauliel: Radiant Angel, embodying the Light of God. A beacon of hope and inspiration, guiding souls towards spiritual growth.

historical_references.reference: Rauliel was a legendary Basque shepherd who lived in the 12th century. According to one legend, he was visited by the Blessed Virgin Mary who appeared to him in a cave and asked him to build a church at a nearby site. Rauliel complied, and the site became the location of the famous Lourdes shrine.

Another reference to Rauliel can be found in the 'Chronicon Sancti Jacobi' written by the monk Abbot Alvarus in the late 10th or early 11th century. In this text, Rauliel is mentioned as a hermit who lived in a cave near the river Irabia in the Pyrenees. He was known for his ascetic lifestyle, prayer, and miraculous healings.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Rauliel, a variation of the traditional Christian name Raúl, is increasingly seen in modern contexts as a symbol of Latino culture and identity. Rauliel is particularly popular among younger generations and is often associated with Latin music and social media presence. Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok are three major platforms where Rauliel is commonly found. On Instagram, Rauliel is often used as a unique username for individuals who want to showcase their Latin heritage and identity. On YouTube, Rauliel is the name of several channels dedicated to Latin music, dance, and culture. On TikTok, Rauliel is a popular name for individuals who create and share content related to Latin music and dance trends.
